verses.ar: مَزْمُورُ تَسْبِيحَةٍ. لِيَوْمِ ٱلسَّبْتِ حَسَنٌ هُوَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلرَّبِّ وَٱلتَّرَنُّمُ لِٱسْمِكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْعَلِيُّ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm [or] Song for the sabbath day. [It is a] good [thing] to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.web: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
verses.he: מִזְמֹ֥ור שִׁ֗יר לְיֹ֣ום הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ טֹ֗וב לְהֹדֹ֥ות לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֹֽון׃

verses.ar: أَنْ يُخْبَرَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي ٱلْغَدَاةِ، وَأَمَانَتِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ،
verses.kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.web: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

verses.ar: عَلَى ذَاتِ عَشَرَةِ أَوْتَارٍ وَعَلَى ٱلرَّبَابِ، عَلَى عَزْفِ ٱلْعُودِ.
verses.kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.web: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ فَرَّحْتَنِي يَارَبُّ بِصَنَائِعِكَ. بِأَعْمَالِ يَدَيْكَ أَبْتَهِجُ.
verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.web: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.he: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

verses.ar: مَا أَعْظَمَ أَعْمَالَكَ يَارَبُّ! وَأَعْمَقَ جِدًّا أَفْكَارَكَ!
verses.kjv: O LORD, how great are thy works! [and] thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.web: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.he: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْبَلِيدُ لَا يَعْرِفُ، وَٱلْجَاهِلُ لَا يَفْهَمُ هَذَا.
verses.kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.web: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
verses.he: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃

verses.ar: إِذَا زَهَا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ كَٱلْعُشْبِ، وَأَزْهَرَ كُلُّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ، فَلِكَيْ يُبَادُوا إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; [it is] that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.web: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.he: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים ׀ כְּמֹ֥ו עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ فَمُتَعَالٍ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: But thou, LORD, [art most] high for evermore.
verses.web: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا أَعْدَاؤُكَ يَارَبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا أَعْدَاؤُكَ يَبِيدُونَ. يَتَبَدَّدُ كُلُّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.web: For behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
verses.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

verses.ar: وَتَنْصِبُ مِثْلَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱلْوَحْشِيِّ قَرْنِي. تَدَهَّنْتُ بِزَيْتٍ طَرِيٍّ.
verses.kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like [the horn of] an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.he: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃

verses.ar: وَتُبْصِرُ عَيْنِي بِمُرَاقِبِيَّ، وَبِٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيَّ بِٱلشَّرِّ تَسْمَعُ أُذُنَايَ.
verses.kjv: Mine eye also shall see [my desire] on mine enemies, [and] mine ears shall hear [my desire] of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.web: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
verses.he: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃

verses.ar: اَلصِّدِّيقُ كَٱلنَّخْلَةِ يَزْهُو، كَٱلْأَرْزِ فِي لُبْنَانَ يَنْمُو.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.he: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנֹ֣ון יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: مَغْرُوسِينَ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ، فِي دِيَارِ إِلَهِنَا يُزْهِرُونَ.
verses.kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.web: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
verses.he: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְרֹ֖ות אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃

verses.ar: أَيْضًا يُثْمِرُونَ فِي ٱلشَّيْبَةِ. يَكُونُونَ دِسَامًا وَخُضْرًا،
verses.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.web: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verses.he: עֹ֖וד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

verses.ar: لِيُخْبِرُوا بِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ. صَخْرَتِي هُوَ وَلَا ظُلْمَ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: To shew that the LORD [is] upright: [he is] my rock, and [there is] no unrighteousness in him.
verses.web: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.he: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־*עֹלָתָה (עַוְלָ֥תָה) בֹּֽו׃
